node.acceptance_condition: Delivers a 100-150 word plain-language characterization of kitsch, a feature-by-feature verdict on its fit to AI-generated art (at least four features), and a statement of the one hardest conceptual tension the essay must address.
node.expected_contribution: The essay's working definition and the analytical bridge between kitsch and AI art.
node.objective: Develop a plain-language working account of what kitsch is (its recognizable features: e.g., pre-digested emotion, formulaic beauty, instant legibility, comfort without risk, sentimentality, repetition of exhausted conventions - without leaning on named theorists) and test AI-generated art against it: which features fit AI output nearly by design, which do not, and where the fit breaks down (e.g., can something be kitsch without a sincere author behind it?).
node.rationale: The essay needs a defensible shared understanding of kitsch before any thesis about AI art can land; this conceptual groundwork is an independent analytical question answerable from general cultural knowledge.
